criterion: A receiving agent can recover exact prepared inputs, build the environment, execute and evaluate. LLM outputs may be stochastic.
scope: All 38 canonical experiment records reconciled; 11 selected core records have maintained reproduction bundles. No new model trials.

environment.docker: Existing Colima arm64 runtime; image IDs recorded per control; network disabled during control and method execution.

verification_boundary: Fresh selected-input materialization; all transferred bundle files verified by size, hash and executable mode.

Each bundle recovered outside the checkout using only copied declared Git sources and --input-root; scoring used the declared existing evaluator environment on this same machine. No access to historical run paths is required by the portable operations.

61 saved task-output comparisons and seven saved transfer-output comparisons match; seven frozen submitted programs reexecuted and produced exactly matching scientific metrics. No byte-identity promise for runtime logs or NPZ archive metadata.
26 oracle and 26 no-op Docker controls produced their expected rewards. These are separate from Harbor attempt-bound qualification controls.
723 original task file hashes remain unchanged. Two new BR-024 native replay observations exercise append-only collection.
Original Dockerfiles retain base tags; tested image IDs are pinned in this receipt, not a claim that future base tags or another architecture are identical.
Inspection covers task text/input inventory and existing group stories; raw viewer regeneration remains outside this core recipe backfill.
Raw/prepared data stay outside Git. Complete local bundles are usable handoffs, not public data releases or remote availability guarantees.

limitations: Masks contain no material identities or tracked landmarks; tangential motion and torsion are not identifiable from boundaries alone.
The inferred map is a smooth signed-distance registration hypothesis, not measured tissue correspondence.
Voxel-cell boundaries are stair-stepped at the supplied sampling resolution.
No strain rate is reported because physical phase duration is unavailable.
No AHA labels are supplied, so no anatomical regional or directional interpretation is asserted.
A cavity has no epicardium or myocardial tissue domain; its computed deformation is only a geometric map for volume/EF checks.
assessment.finding: The cavity supports geometric volume/deformation checks only; the mathematical strain field is not myocardial strain.

limitations: The segmentations contain no material identities or tracked landmarks; fixed vertex indices encode an inferred, non-unique correspondence.
Signed-distance registration and smoothness regularization impose a motion prior and do not establish true tissue motion.
Ultrasound intensity, when present, is used only as a weak texture cue; it is neither blood velocity nor a reference deformation.
No epicardial/endocardial labels, AHA regions, fibre directions, or constitutive/equilibrium model are supplied.
Timestamps in seconds are absent, so no strain rate in s^-1 is reported.
Boundary accuracy is limited by voxel-centre sampling and the native voxel-cell representation.
A cavity alone has no myocardial wall or epicardium, so its F/E fields are only a parameterization of cavity geometry.
assessment.finding: The cavity deformation supports geometric volume/EF checks only; its mathematical strain must not be interpreted as myocardial strain.
